set.body:
Correct NIfTI semantic read APIs before they stabilize.

Required API
- Distinguish readRaw, explicit readAs[A](conversionPolicy), readScaledFloat, readScaledDouble, and readLabels or an equally precise surface.
- readLabels preserves exact categorical values or rejects slope/intercept combinations that cannot remain exact categorical values.
- Recover non-spatial coordinate sampling: temporal spacing/unit to a regular Time axis when justified; other axes use ordinal or caller-supplied semantics.
- Add qform/sform policy: PreferSform, PreferQform, RequireAgreement(tolerance), and explicit override.
- Decoded output retains qform/sform disagreement diagnostics and the original header sidecar.
- State the supported NIfTI-1 datatype and feature subset accurately.

Acceptance criteria
- No API named labels can silently return fractionally scaled categories.
- Conversion and precision loss are caller-visible.
- Float32 input need not automatically become Double.
- A 4D time series retains its temporal coordinate semantics.
- qform/sform disagreement cannot pass silently when the selected policy forbids it.

Tests
- Cross-product of supported endian, datatype, slope/intercept, and conversion policies.
- Exact integral-label round trips and rejection of fractional scaling.
- Float32/Float64 precision fixtures and integer range/overflow boundaries.
- Time-axis recovery for seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, and unknown-unit policy.
- qform-only, sform-only, agreement, disagreement, fallback, and explicit override cases.
- Raw versus scaled round-trip checksums.
- JVM and Node.js parity across single, pair, gzip, and extension-bearing files.
set.title: Correct NIfTI dtype, label, axis, and affine-selection semantics
